tools.name: health
tools.title: Health check
tools.description: Check Spoonjoy API readiness and whether the caller can use owner-scoped write operations.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.title: Authentication status
tools.description: Report the current Spoonjoy MCP authentication state and how an agent should obtain delegated access without asking for raw user credentials.

tools.name: start_agent_connection
tools.title: Start delegated connection
tools.description: Start a browser-approved delegated Spoonjoy connection for this agent. Show the user authorizationUrl and, separately, userCode: they open the link, sign in and type the code to approve. Then poll with deviceCode. Grants kitchen and shopping-list scopes only, never account access.

agentName.description: The agent's name, shown to the person when they approve.

baseUrl.description: The Spoonjoy server's URL, when it isn't the default.

scopes.description: The scopes to ask for, separated by spaces or commas.

tools.name: poll_agent_connection
tools.title: Poll delegated connection
tools.description: Poll a pending delegated Spoonjoy connection. When approved, the Spoonjoy MCP bridge activates and caches access; never ask for a Spoonjoy password.

tokenName.description: The name to give the token once approved.

baseUrl.description: The Spoonjoy server's URL, when it isn't the default.

tools.name: create_api_token
tools.title: Create API token
tools.description: Create an owner-scoped Spoonjoy API token. The token is returned once and is stored hashed.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

oneOf.description: The scopes, separated by spaces or commas.

scopes.description: The token's scopes, as one string separated by spaces or commas, or as a list.

expiresInDays.description: Days until the token expires, 1 to 365. Defaults to 90. Pass null or "never" for a token that never expires.

tools.name: list_api_tokens
tools.title: List API tokens
tools.description: List API token metadata for the configured owner. Token secrets are never returned.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

tools.name: revoke_api_token
tools.title: Revoke API token
tools.description: Revoke one API token owned by the configured owner.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

tools.name: search_spoonjoy
tools.title: Search Spoonjoy
tools.description: Full-text search Spoonjoy recipes, cookbooks, chefs, and the configured owner's private shopping list. Without commas every query word must match; commas separate alternatives, so a result matching any of them is returned, ordered by how many alternatives it matches, and at most 12 alternatives are used.

query.description: The words to search for. Every word must match; commas separate alternatives, any of which may match.

scope.description: What to search: all, or one kind of result.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

limit.description: The most results to return, 1 to 25.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.title: Search recipes
tools.description: Full-text search Spoonjoy recipes by title, description, source URL, steps and ingredients, optionally limited to one chef by username, or to your own recipes by your own chefEmail. Without commas every query word must match; commas separate alternatives, so a result matching any of them is returned, ordered by how many alternatives it matches, and at most 12 alternatives are used.

query.description: The words to search for. Every word must match; commas separate alternatives, any of which may match.

chefUsername.description: Only recipes by the chef with this username.

chefEmail.description: Only your own recipes: must be your own email. Any other address returns no recipes.

limit.description: The most results to return, 1 to 25.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.title: Get recipe
tools.description: Fetch a Spoonjoy recipe by id or exact title with ordered steps and ingredients.

id.description: The recipe's id. Give this or its title.

title.description: The recipe's exact title, when you don't have its id.

tools.name: create_recipe
tools.title: Create recipe
tools.description: Create a Spoonjoy recipe for the configured owner, including steps and ingredients.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

description.description: A short description of the recipe.

servings.description: How many it serves, such as 4 or 4-6.

sourceUrl.description: Where the recipe came from, as a URL.

imageUrl.description: A Spoonjoy image URL from upload_recipe_image.

steps.description: The recipe's steps, in order, each with its ingredients.

description.description: What to do in this step.

duration.description: How long the step takes, in minutes.

name.description: What it is, such as flour.

unit.description: The unit for the quantity, such as grams or cups.

tools.name: update_recipe
tools.title: Update recipe
tools.description: Update a recipe owned by the configured owner. With steps, the recipe's steps become the given list, in order: a step with an id updates that step, a step without one updates the step at its position or is added, and steps left out are removed. Updated steps keep their ids, their ingredients keep theirs, and a step keeps the steps whose output it uses unless outputStepNums says otherwise. Each ingredient appears in one step only.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

description.description: A short description of the recipe, or null to clear it.

servings.description: How many it serves, or null to clear it.

sourceUrl.description: Where the recipe came from, as a URL, or null to clear it.

imageUrl.description: A Spoonjoy image URL from upload_recipe_image, or null to clear it.

steps.description: The recipe's steps, in order; steps left out are removed.

id.description: The id of the step this one updates.

description.description: What to do in this step.

duration.description: How long the step takes, in minutes.

name.description: What it is, such as flour.

unit.description: The unit for the quantity, such as grams or cups.

outputStepNums.description: Earlier step numbers, in this list's order, whose output this step uses.

tools.name: delete_recipe
tools.title: Delete recipe
tools.description: Soft-delete a recipe owned by the configured owner.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

tools.name: upload_recipe_image
tools.title: Upload recipe image
tools.description: Upload a recipe photo from base64 bytes and return a Spoonjoy image URL for recipe cover assignment.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

filename.description: The photo's file name, such as lasagna.jpg.

tools.name: fork_recipe
tools.title: Fork recipe
tools.description: Fork an existing Spoonjoy recipe into the authenticated principal's kitchen. Clones title, description, servings, steps, ingredients, and step-output uses; snapshots the source's latest cover; sets sourceRecipeId on the new recipe. Retrying the same fork (the same idempotencyKey, or the same source and title without a key) within 24 hours returns the first fork instead of creating another, unless that fork was deleted.

sourceRecipeId.description: The recipe to fork, by id.

title.description: Optional title override. Subject to the same `(chefId, title)` collision suffixing as the default title.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for a replay-safe fork; reuse it when retrying.

tools.name: add_shopping_list_item
tools.title: Add to list
tools.description: Add or restore one item on the person's shopping list. It adds to the quantity of a matching item still on the list (same ingredient and unit); a removed or cleared matching item comes back at the added quantity, not on top of its old one.

name.description: What to buy, such as eggs or flour.

quantity.description: How many or how much, as a number above 0. Leave it out when it doesn't matter.

unit.description: The unit for the quantity, such as grams, cups or cans. Leave it out for a plain count.

categoryKey.description: Optional. The aisle's category key, such as produce or pantry.

iconKey.description: Optional. The item's icon key, such as wheat or package.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key again when retrying this exact call, such as after a timeout, and the item is added once.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose list, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts on their own list.

tools.name: get_shopping_list
tools.title: Get shopping list
tools.description: Fetch the configured owner shopping list.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

tools.name: search_shopping_list
tools.title: Search shopping list
tools.description: Full-text search the configured owner's private shopping list by ingredient, unit, category, icon, and checked state. Without commas every query word must match; commas separate alternatives, so a result matching any of them is returned, ordered by how many alternatives it matches, and at most 12 alternatives are used.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

query.description: The words to search for. Every word must match; commas separate alternatives, any of which may match.

limit.description: The most results to return, 1 to 25.

tools.name: set_shopping_list_item_checked
tools.title: Check shopping-list item
tools.description: Set checked state for one active item on the configured owner shopping list.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

checked.description: True to check the item off, false to uncheck it.

tools.name: remove_shopping_list_item
tools.title: Remove shopping-list item
tools.description: Soft-remove one item from the configured owner shopping list.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

tools.name: add_recipe_to_shopping_list
tools.title: Add recipe to shopping list
tools.description: Add all ingredients from a recipe to the configured owner shopping list. Each ingredient adds to the quantity of a matching item still on the list (same ingredient and unit); a removed or cleared matching item comes back at the added quantity, not on top of its old one.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

recipeId.description: The recipe whose ingredients to add, by id.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key again when retrying this exact call, such as after a timeout, and the items are added once.

tools.name: list_cookbooks
tools.title: List cookbooks
tools.description: List cookbooks owned by the configured owner, with active recipe counts and covers.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

query.description: Only cookbooks whose title has these words.

limit.description: The most results to return, 1 to 25.

tools.name: get_cookbook
tools.title: Get cookbook
tools.description: Fetch one cookbook owned by the configured owner by cookbookId or exact title.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

cookbookId.description: The cookbook's id. Give this or its title.

title.description: The cookbook's exact title, when you don't have its id.

cookbookTitle.description: The same as title; title wins when both are given.

tools.name: create_cookbook
tools.title: Create cookbook
tools.description: Create or return an existing cookbook for the configured owner by exact title.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

title.description: The cookbook's title; an existing cookbook with this exact title is returned instead.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key (8-100 letters, digits, '_' or '-') for replay-safe creation: a repeat with the same key returns the cookbook the first call made, with created: true and mutation.replayed: true.

tools.name: add_recipe_to_cookbook
tools.title: Add recipe to cookbook
tools.description: Idempotently add an active recipe to a cookbook owned by the configured owner.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

cookbookId.description: The cookbook's id. Give this or its title.

title.description: The cookbook's exact title, when you don't have its id.

cookbookTitle.description: The same as title; title wins when both are given.

tools.name: remove_recipe_from_cookbook
tools.title: Remove recipe from cookbook
tools.description: Idempotently remove a recipe from a cookbook owned by the configured owner.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

cookbookId.description: The cookbook's id. Give this or its title.

title.description: The cookbook's exact title, when you don't have its id.

cookbookTitle.description: The same as title; title wins when both are given.

tools.name: create_spoon
tools.title: Log a cook
tools.description: Create a RecipeSpoon (cook event) authored by the authenticated principal.

recipeId.description: The recipe that was cooked, by id.

photoUrl.description: A Spoonjoy image URL from upload_spoon_photo.

nextTime.description: What to do differently next time.

cookedAt.description: When it was cooked, as an ISO date-time; now when left out.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key (8-100 letters, digits, '_' or '-') for replay-safe creation: a repeat with the same key returns the spoon the first call made instead of logging a second cook.

tools.name: update_spoon
tools.title: Update a cook
tools.description: Update note, nextTime, photoUrl, or cookedAt on a spoon owned by the authenticated principal.

nextTime.description: What to do differently next time.

photoUrl.description: A Spoonjoy image URL from upload_spoon_photo, or null to remove the photo.

cookedAt.description: When it was cooked, as an ISO date-time; now when left out.

tools.name: delete_spoon
tools.title: Delete a cook
tools.description: Soft-delete a spoon owned by the authenticated principal.

tools.name: list_spoons_for_recipe
tools.title: List cooks for recipe
tools.description: List the most-recent non-deleted spoons for a recipe.

tools.name: list_spoons_by_chef
tools.title: List cooks by chef
tools.description: List the chef's most-recent non-deleted spoons across all recipes.

tools.name: upload_spoon_photo
tools.title: Upload spoon photo
tools.description: Upload a spoon/cook photo from base64 bytes and return a Spoonjoy image URL for spoon assignment.

ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

filename.description: The photo's file name, such as dinner.jpg.

tools.name: list_recipe_covers
tools.title: List recipe covers
tools.description: List Recipe Photo Studio cover candidates. Owners with kitchen write access receive full cover history; other readers receive active public cover metadata only. May record that an abandoned generation failed: a cover still processing ten minutes after its generation started is reported, and stored, as failed.

recipeId.description: Recipe whose cover candidates should be listed.

includeArchived.description: Include archived cover candidates in the owner-only history.

limit.description: Maximum number of cover candidates to return.

tools.name: list_recipe_spoon_images
tools.title: List recipe spoon images
tools.description: List owner-only Spoon photos that can be used as Recipe Photo Studio cover sources.

recipeId.description: Recipe whose Spoon photos should be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of Spoon photos to return.

tools.name: create_recipe_cover_from_upload
tools.title: Create recipe cover from upload
tools.description: Create a Recipe Photo Studio cover candidate from an uploaded recipe or spoon photo URL.

recipeId.description: Recipe that will receive the cover candidate.

imageUrl.description: Spoonjoy uploaded recipe or spoon photo URL to use as the original cover source.

activateWhenReady.description: Make the cover active when the editorial image is ready.

generateEditorial.description: Generate an editorialized cover from the uploaded original photo.

promptAddition.description: Optional bounded instruction to guide editorial cover generation.

postAsSpoon.description: Also create a Spoon entry to preserve the original photo with optional cook notes.

note.description: Spoon note used when postAsSpoon preserves the original photo.

nextTime.description: Spoon next-time note used when postAsSpoon preserves the original photo.

cookedAt.description: ISO date-time for the Spoon cook when postAsSpoon preserves the original photo.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for replay-safe cover creation.

dryRun.description: Validate inputs and return planned next actions without writing a cover.

tools.name: generate_recipe_cover_placeholder
tools.title: Generate recipe cover placeholder
tools.description: Generate an AI placeholder cover candidate for a recipe with an optional prompt addition.

recipeId.description: Recipe that will receive the generated AI placeholder cover.

promptAddition.description: Optional bounded instruction to guide AI placeholder generation.

activateWhenReady.description: Make the generated cover active when the generated cover is ready.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for replay-safe placeholder generation.

dryRun.description: Validate inputs and return planned next actions without writing a cover.

tools.name: regenerate_recipe_cover
tools.title: Regenerate recipe cover
tools.description: Regenerate the editorial image for a recipe cover candidate with an optional prompt addition.

recipeId.description: Recipe that owns the cover candidate.

promptAddition.description: Optional bounded instruction to guide regenerated editorial output.

activateWhenReady.description: Make the regenerated cover active when the regenerated cover is ready.

dryRun.description: Validate inputs and return planned next actions without writing a cover.

tools.name: get_cover_generation_status
tools.title: Get cover generation status
tools.description: Fetch Recipe Photo Studio generation status and active-cover context. May record that an abandoned generation failed: a cover still processing ten minutes after its generation started is reported, and stored, as failed, so polling can stop.

recipeId.description: Recipe that owns the cover candidate.

coverId.description: Recipe cover candidate whose generation status should be fetched.

tools.name: set_active_recipe_cover
tools.title: Set active recipe cover
tools.description: Set one existing Recipe Photo Studio cover variant as the active recipe cover.

recipeId.description: Recipe that owns the cover candidate.

variant.description: Cover variant to activate: image or stylized.

tools.name: set_recipe_no_cover
tools.title: Set recipe no cover
tools.description: Set an explicit no-cover state for a recipe after destructive no-cover confirmation.

recipeId.description: Recipe that should intentionally display no cover.

confirmNoCover.description: Required explicit confirmation before entering no-cover mode.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for replay-safe no-cover changes.

tools.name: archive_recipe_cover
tools.title: Archive recipe cover
tools.description: Archive a Recipe Photo Studio cover. Archiving the active cover requires a replacement or explicit no-cover confirmation.

recipeId.description: Recipe that owns the cover candidate.

replacementCoverId.description: Replacement cover candidate to activate when archiving the active cover.

replacementVariant.description: Replacement variant to activate: image or stylized.

confirmNoCover.description: Use explicit no-cover mode when archiving the active cover without a replacement.

deleteSafeObjects.description: Request deletion of safe owned image objects after archive when supported.

approve_agent_connection.summary: connection approve: You can't approve access to the person's Spoonjoy account; only they can. Ask the person, who does it with Approve access on the connection page, after typing the code you showed them.

error.problem: You can't approve access to the person's Spoonjoy account; only they can. Ask the person, who does it with Approve access on the connection page, after typing the code you showed them
error.message: connection approve: You can't approve access to the person's Spoonjoy account; only they can. Ask the person, who does it with Approve access on the connection page, after typing the code you showed them.
